Package com.egradx.core.audit

Class EgradxAuditEvent

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.core.audit.EgradxAuditEvent
public final class EgradxAuditEvent extends Object
Something worth an audit record: who did what, to what, with what result.

Libraries publish these as ordinary Spring application events (ApplicationEventPublisher.publishEvent); egradx-audit, when present, stores them — without it they go nowhere. An application records through EgradxAuditor instead.

Actions are named category.entity.verb, lower case with underscores — auth.password.changed, oim.order.status_changed. The category is the first segment unless set. Every value is checked when the event is built, so a malformed event fails where it is written — in a test — not inside someone's transaction.

before, after and details are stored as JSON. Pass plain values, maps or response objects, never persistent entities; secrets are redacted by key when stored, but should not be passed at all.
